n.exclusions: Belgium removed because only four data were available. Differencing/instrument lags are specified, but equation-specific usable observation losses are not enumerated.

notes: Published article title and DOI match assigned original reference. Requested individual test statistic is not printed: Table 5 reports coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, not individual t/z statistics. Preserved the printed coefficient without calculating coefficient/SE. Standard error for this coefficient is 0.063. Joint EXCLM/EXCLG Wald tests and Hansen J tests are different tests and were not substituted. p is the upper significance threshold indicated by the printed star legend, not an exact p-value. The n value records the explicitly identified 12-country analysis panel, not an inferred country-year observation count. Replication and narrative success were not examined, as this is original-only validation.
